tut_pickBox: Tap an empty shelf! You'll grab goods from its box and stock it. (You can also tap the box the arrow points to)
tut_fillShelf: Got the goods! Tap the shelf for that product to stock it.
tut_checkout: Customers are lining up. Tap the register to stand behind it and check out.
tut_collect: The money piles up next to the register. Walk close to collect it.

intro_1:
Welcome, new manager!
You're taking over Grandma's little corner store.
intro_2:
Stock what customers want, check them out, and grow the store with what you earn.
Listen to your regulars' stories too.
intro_3:
Turn a tiny shop into the best store in town!
You can even open stores by the beach, downtown and in a snowy village.
b_piyak_desc: The cozy town where it all begins
b_beach_desc: A summer village that loves ice cream and watermelon
b_night_desc: A sparkling street where hot dogs and pizza fly off the shelves
b_snow_desc: A winter village craving warm coffee and cake
reg_mina_intro: A college student who buys donuts every exam week
reg_mina_h1: "You have donuts? Phew… I'm pulling an all-nighter tonight."
reg_mina_h3: "Exams are over! I told all my friends about this place."
reg_mina_h4: "Actually, I want to be a baker. Would you sell my donuts here someday?"
reg_mina_h5: "I got into baking school! It's thanks to you. Thank you so much!"
reg_jun_intro: An office worker who grabs a sandwich on the way to work
reg_jun_h1: "A sandwich is all I need for breakfast. Quick checkout, please?"
reg_jun_h2: "Stopping by here makes my day feel a little less busy."
reg_jun_h3: "I have a big presentation today… wish me luck!"
reg_jun_h4: "The presentation went great! I might get promoted."
reg_jun_h5: "I'm team leader now. I'll buy all our team snacks here!"
reg_sora_intro: A surfer who wants ice cream after riding the waves
reg_sora_h1: "Ice cream after surfing is the best!"
reg_sora_h2: "The waves were amazing today. Want to try surfing sometime?"
reg_sora_h3: "I signed up for a competition. I'm so nervous…"
reg_sora_h4: "I made it through the heats! Two ice creams today, right?"
reg_sora_h5: "I won! I'll use the prize money to start surf lessons for the village kids."
reg_taeo_intro: A fisherman who buys watermelon after the dawn catch
reg_taeo_h1: "Heh, after the sea breeze I always crave cold watermelon."
reg_taeo_h3: "This spot used to be a net shed. Time flies."
reg_taeo_h4: "Young folks like you are bringing the village back to life."
reg_taeo_h5: "The biggest fish I caught today is yours. Thanks for everything!"
reg_rin_intro: A night DJ who comes for pizza after the show
reg_rin_h1: "I'm starving after the show. You've got pizza, right?"
reg_rin_h2: "Who picks the music in here? Great taste!"
reg_rin_h3: "I'm making a new track. It's called 'Midnight Store'."
reg_rin_h4: "The track is out! The first beat is the sound of your door opening."
reg_rin_h5: "I drew this store on my first album cover. Is that okay?"
reg_dal_intro: An all-night taxi driver powered by hot dogs
reg_dal_h1: "Gotta have a hot dog to drive all night!"
reg_dal_h2: "When passengers ask where to get good snacks, I send them here."
reg_dal_h3: "Today I drove a lost kid all the way home."
reg_dal_h4: "My daughter's getting married next month. I'm all choked up."
reg_dal_h5: "I'd love to get the wedding favors here. Will you help?"
reg_yuki_intro: A ski instructor who warms up frozen hands here
reg_yuki_h1: "One warm coffee and my frozen hands thaw out."
reg_yuki_h2: "A little student made it down without falling for the first time today!"
reg_yuki_h3: "I actually came from another country. This is my second home."
reg_yuki_h4: "Seeing your store lights makes me feel safe even in a blizzard."
reg_yuki_h5: "I've decided to live here for good! Let's keep being friends."
reg_bom_intro: A sweet granddaughter who buys cake for every birthday
reg_bom_h1: "Grandma loves the cake from this store the most."
reg_bom_h2: "I saved up my allowance to buy it today!"
reg_bom_h3: "Grandma said to tell you thank you."
reg_bom_h4: "Grandma and I wrote you a letter. Please take it!"
reg_bom_h5: "Grandma's coming herself this birthday. Please celebrate with us!"
help_move_b: Tap where to go or what to use, and you'll walk there and do it. Drag with one finger to move the map, pinch with two to zoom. Prefer a joystick? Turn it on in Settings.
help_stock_b: Tap an empty shelf (red !) and you'll stop by its supply box and come back to stock it. To stock a shelf, the store needs a supply box for that product.
help_checkout_b: Tap the register to stand on the blue spot behind it and check out. Money you ring up piles up next to the register, so walk close to collect it. Hire a cashier and money comes straight in.
help_build_b: Tap the hammer at the bottom right to enter build mode. Pick something, drag or tap the preview into place, then press ✓. Tap a placed item to move, change product, rotate, level up or sell it.
help_customers_b: Customers get disappointed if what they want is missing or the line is too long. A higher rating and more shelves and decorations bring customers more often. Without a trash bin nearby they litter, so place bins.
help_staff_b: Cashiers run registers, stockers carry boxes to shelves, janitors clean trash. A section manager makes that section restock itself without boxes and sell for more. Staff are paid every minute.
help_levelup_b: Level up a shelf to hold more and sell for more. Level up a register to check out faster. In build mode, tap the fixture and press the ⬆ button.
help_regulars_b: Customers with a heart over their head are regulars. Sell them what they're looking for to earn hearts. Each heart unlocks a story and a reward. Read them again in the Regulars book.
help_branches_b: As you level up you can open new stores in Beach Village, Night Street and Snow Village. Money and level are shared, but each store grows on its own. Each town's featured products sell for 20% more.
help_goals_b: Complete the goal at the top left for a reward. Sometimes a rush of customers or VIP guests who pay double arrive. While the app is closed, cashiers and managers keep earning a little.
placed_hint: Placed! Tap a placed item to move or sell it
